svg.title: Secrets and Variables: the Most Specific Scope Wins
svg.desc: Organization, repository and environment secrets are stacked with the environment level winning name collisions, environment secrets unlock only after reviewer approval, and non-sensitive values live in variables.
svg.text: Secrets and Variables: the Most Specific Scope Wins
Environment beats repository beats organization; non-sensitive values are variables.
Wins name collisions. Only jobs that declare the environment, after its reviewers approve.
Every workflow in the repository can read it.
All or selected repositories share it.
Hostnames, regions, flags: not sensitive, shown in logs.
